faq.title: FAQ
faq.freeAnswer: Yes. Paseo is free and open source. You need agent providers installed with your own credentials. Voice is local-first by default and can optionally use cloud speech providers if you configure them.
faq.codeQuestion: Does my code leave my machine?
faq.codeAnswer: Paseo doesn't send your code anywhere. Agents run locally and talk to their own APIs as they normally would. For remote access, you can use the optional <relay>end-to-end encrypted relay</relay>, connect directly over your local network, or use your own tunnel.
faq.agentsAnswer: Paseo supports many providers. It has custom implementations for Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, OMP, Antigravity, and Muse Code, and supports many more via ACP. See the full list here: <agents>all supported providers</agents>. See <muse>Muse Code setup and limitations</muse>.
faq.providersAnswer: Paseo runs the providers installed on your machine as you'd normally run them. Paseo doesn't modify or change their behavior.
faq.desktopQuestion: Do I need the desktop app?
faq.desktopAnswer: No. You can run the daemon headless and use any client to connect. The desktop app just bundles the daemon with a UI.
faq.voiceAnswer: Voice runs locally on your device by default. You talk, the app transcribes and sends it to your agent as text. Optionally, you can configure OpenAI speech providers for higher-quality transcription and text-to-speech. See the <voice>voice docs</voice>.
faq.networkQuestion: Can I connect from outside my network?
faq.networkAnswer: Yes. You can use the hosted relay (end-to-end encrypted, Paseo can't read your traffic), set up your own tunnel (Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, etc.), or expose the daemon port directly. See <configuration>configuration</configuration>.
faq.gitQuestion: Do I need git or GitHub?
faq.gitAnswer: No. Paseo works in any directory. Worktrees are optional and only relevant if you use git. You can run agents anywhere you'd normally work.
faq.banQuestion: Can I get banned for using Paseo?
faq.banAnswer: Paseo is designed to use each provider's officially supported integration and does not attempt to bypass its terms of service. It doesn't extract tokens or call inference APIs directly.
faq.worktreesAnswer: When you launch an agent with the worktree option (from the app, desktop, or CLI), Paseo creates a git worktree and runs the agent inside it. The agent works on an isolated branch without touching your main working directory. See the <worktrees>worktrees docs</worktrees>.

note.maintained: It is maintained by one person, full time, and shaped by the community. There are no investors, no board and no company behind it. I have turned down funding offers to keep it that way.
note.community: The community helps Paseo grow through feedback, testing, bug reports, code contributions and plugins. Your sponsorship helps me keep improving and maintaining it.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.whatAnswer: A separate service that sits above your Paseo daemons. You connect one or more daemons to it and it gives them GitHub, Slack, and Discord triggers, with collaboration features planned. Paseo works fully without it.
faq.separateQuestion: Why is it a separate service instead of part of the daemon?
faq.separateAnswer1: The daemon stays one lean executable on one machine. The Hub talks to daemons over the same RPCs the app and the CLI use, so anyone can build their own hub on top of Paseo.
faq.separateAnswer2: It also has a different job. The Hub is meant to be exposed to the internet, shared with a team, and run multi-tenant. None of that belongs in a single machine daemon.
faq.selfHostAnswer: Yes. Run npx @getpaseo/hub and complete setup in the browser. The source is available on GitHub, and the self-hosting guide covers more involved deployments.
faq.needQuestion: What do I need to run it?
faq.needAnswer: Node.js and a running Paseo daemon. Hub guides you through connecting the provider apps you want.
faq.hostedAnswer: Yes. The hosted service runs the same Hub software you can self-host.
faq.plannedIntro: Not built yet, listed so you know where this is going.
faq.plannedSharing: Sharing settings and skills across a team
faq.moveQuestion: Do I have to move my team to a new tool?
faq.moveAnswer: No. The Hub works in the Slack or Discord your team already uses, and on the daemons you already run. When the work gets serious you switch to the Paseo app on those same daemons.
faq.agentsAnswer: Whichever ones your daemons have configured, with your own subscriptions and skills. The Hub ships no agent of its own.
faq.codeQuestion: Can the Hub run code on my machines?
faq.codeAnswer: Yes, on the daemons you connect to it and nowhere else. That is the whole point of triggers, and it's why access to the beta stays small and trusted.
faq.accessAnswer: You can self-host today or <hosted>sign in to Hosted Hub</hosted> for a free account. When you want more agent runs or more seats, upgrade from Billing inside Hub.
